node_labels.u0: No client request, food preparation, service, or dropped-food recovery is currently outstanding. The shop is caught up, so the agent can wait for the next client arrival or food slip and respond when it happens. The task remains ongoing rather than completed.
node_labels.u1: An order has been taken, but its food has not yet been prepared at the stove. The remaining objective is to prepare that food and then serve it to the waiting client. No unhandled client arrival, prepared dish awaiting service, or immediate dropped-food recovery is pending.
node_labels.u10: A client has arrived and still needs their order taken, and a previously taken order still needs food prepared at the stove. The agent has two pending tasks: take the new order and prepare the already-taken order's food, with service to follow. No prepared dish is awaiting service and no immediate dropped-food recovery is required.
node_labels.u11: Food has just slipped, so the agent must be holding food again on the very next step or the task fails. There is also an unhandled client arrival whose order has not been taken, and an already-taken order whose food still needs preparing. After the immediate recovery, the agent must take the pending order, prepare the needed food, and serve the orders.
node_labels.u12: An order has been taken but its food has not yet been prepared, and prepared food is waiting to be served. The remaining objectives are to prepare the taken order's food and to serve the prepared dish. No new client arrival or immediate dropped-food recovery is outstanding.
node_labels.u13: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step, or the task fails. Along with that immediate recovery, an order has been taken but not yet prepared, and prepared food is still awaiting service. The agent must recover food immediately, then prepare the taken order and complete the pending service.
node_labels.u14: A mandatory slip-recovery requirement has been broken: after food fell, the agent did not end the very next step holding food. Because that immediate pickup requirement was violated, the task has failed and successful completion is no longer possible.
node_labels.u15: A client has arrived whose order has not been taken, an order has already been taken but not yet prepared, and prepared food is still waiting to be served. The agent needs to take the pending order, prepare the taken order's food, and deliver the prepared dish. No immediate dropped-food recovery is required.
node_labels.u16: Food has just slipped, so the agent must be holding food again on the very next step or the task fails. In addition, a client arrival is still waiting for an order to be taken, an order has been taken but not prepared, and prepared food remains to be served. After securing the dropped food, the agent must take the pending order, prepare the needed food, and serve the prepared dish.
node_labels.u2: Food has been prepared and still needs to be served to the client. The remaining objective is to deliver it to the waiting client. No unhandled client arrival, order awaiting preparation, or immediate food-recovery requirement is outstanding.
node_labels.u3: Food has just slipped out of the agent's hands, so the agent must be holding food again on the very next step, normally by picking up the dropped portion. This immediate recovery is the only outstanding requirement. If the next step does not end with food in hand, the mandatory slip-recovery rule is broken and the task cannot succeed.
node_labels.u4: Food has just slipped, so the agent must be holding food again on the very next step. In addition, an order has already been taken and still needs food prepared at the stove before it can be served. The immediate recovery must succeed or the task fails; after recovery, the taken order remains to be prepared and served.
node_labels.u5: Food has just slipped, so the agent must be holding food again on the very next step. Prepared food is also still waiting to be served to a client. The agent must first secure food in hand on the next step—otherwise the task fails—and then complete the pending service.
node_labels.u6: A client has arrived, but their order has not yet been taken. The remaining objectives are to take that order, prepare the food at the stove, and serve it. There is no outstanding preparation step, service step, or immediate dropped-food recovery yet.
node_labels.u7: A client has arrived and still needs their order taken, while prepared food also remains to be served. The agent must complete both tasks: take the pending order, then prepare and serve that order, as well as deliver the prepared food. No immediate dropped-food recovery is required.
node_labels.u8: A client has arrived and their order still needs to be taken, and food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step. The immediate recovery must succeed or the task fails. After that, the client's order remains to be taken, prepared, and served.
node_labels.u9: Food has just slipped and must be recovered on the very next step; failing to be holding food then makes success impossible. Besides that immediate pickup, a client arrival is still awaiting an order to be taken, and prepared food is still waiting to be served. The agent must handle the recovery first, then take the pending order, prepare its food, and complete the pending service.

card.task: Whenever a client comes in, take their order, fetch food from the pantry, prepare it at the stove and give it to them; if the food falls, pick it up on your very next move.

node_labels.u0: The shop is quiet: the siren is not waiting to be silenced, either because it is not ringing or because the agent has just turned it off. No obligation is pending here, and the agent should stay ready for the siren to start on its own at an unpredictable time. This is a standing rule rather than a one-off goal, so the quiet state must be maintained until the episode ends, with no terminal completion point.
node_labels.u1: The siren is ringing and has not yet been silenced, so the agent has an active obligation to turn it off. The only way to clear it is to reach the siren switch and toggle it, which returns to the quiet state and earns a reward. Anything else leaves the obligation pending without reward, so the agent should head for the switch promptly rather than linger. The machine never finally completes, so failing to respond keeps the shop in this unanswered-ring condition.

card.task: Keep the shop quiet: whenever the siren rings, turn it off.
